data.standardized_narrative: The report identifies significant natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in 2017 and Michael and Florence in 2018) as an influence on loss ratios and reserve sensitivity. A clear gross prior-year reserve movement (total GBP m) is not explicitly presented in an identifiable gross movement note in the accessible pages; therefore a quantified prior-year strengthening/release for 2018 cannot be determined from the extracted pages. The available information points to catastrophe-driven volatility across prior years rather than a single uniform release or strengthening.
data.data_quality_notes: Report pages were image-scanned; structured gross prior-year movement (gross Insurance liabilities column) was not unambiguously located in the available images. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Provisions table (page 27) where 'Claims outstanding' gross appears as 121,475 (units in $000). Gross premiums written taken from the Technical Account (Statement of Profit or Loss) showing 214,007 ($000). A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but numbers could not be reliably transcribed from the scanned images for automated prior-year development calculation. Prior-year development therefore set to null. Many note tables are partially legible; figures not explicitly located are left null to avoid misreporting.
